parent: Qualified-complement diagonal one-body self-energy before F/Q averaging; explicit orthogonal full-DFT bath with mixed Coulomb vertices
dielectric: I + B_native B_native^T + eta B_bath B_bath^T
calibration: Use the already exposed original-development Furan V010 and Furofuran C002 states to balance their opposite errors. Interpolate their maximum absolute errors from eta=1 and eta=0.65 and round the estimated crossing near 0.60 to two significant figures. Freeze before the complete-ledger calculation. This is calibration, not parameter-free theory or blind validation.
configuration_space: Original frozen screened-even CID; no auxiliary singles and no residue renormalization
test_scope: All 23 states are exposed development. The remaining 21 states were not used to set eta, but are not claimed as a blind benchmark.
runtime: Frozen prepared operators, unchanged analytic first/second nuclear response; no DFT/TDA/SCC driver after preparation
